gloss: private car; personal automobile; family car

definitions.gloss: private car; personal automobile; family car
definitions.explanation: A car owned by a private individual or household for personal use, as opposed to a company car, taxi, or rental vehicle. In Japan, private cars have white-background license plates, distinguishing them from commercial vehicles, which use green-background plates.

examples.japanese: {自家用車|じかようしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自家用車|じかようしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: In the countryside, a private car is indispensable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{自家用車|じかようしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{新|あたら}しく→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{買|か}い{替|か}えた→買い替える：19456_kaikaeru⟧。
examples.english: Taking our marriage as an opportunity, we traded in our private car for a new one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都心|としん}→都心：04072_toshin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}{代|だい}→駐車場代：26235_chuushajoudai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{自家用車|じかようしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}たない→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Since parking fees are high in the city center, many households do not own a private car.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{自家|じか}→自家：14071_jika⟧ (one's own home/household) + ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (for use) + ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (car). A formal or written-style term; in casual conversation, ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ or ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ is more common.

USAGE:
- Appears frequently on official forms (insurance, tax filings, registrations) where the distinction between private and commercial use matters.
- {自家用車|じかようしゃ}⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧ (commuting by private car) is a common phrase in employment and tax contexts — some companies offer a gasoline allowance for such employees.
- The corresponding license plate color in Japan is white for ⟦{自家用|じかよう}→自家用：21401_jikayou⟧ and green for {事業用|じぎょうよう} (business use).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自家用車|じかようしゃ}⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧: commuting by private car
- {自家用車|じかようしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{所有|しょゆう}→所有：12752_shoyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to own a private car
- {自家用車|じかようしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{移動|いどう}する→移動する：22430_idousuru⟧: to travel by private car
- {自家用車|じかようしゃ}⟦{保有|ほゆう}→保有：11615_hoyuu⟧⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: private car ownership rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦マイカー→マイカー：30031_maikaa⟧: "my car" (wasei-eigo) — more casual and colloquial, same basic meaning
- ⟦{社用車|しゃようしゃ}→社用車：30053_shayousha⟧: company car — owned by the company, not the individual
- ⟦{営業車|えいぎょうしゃ}→営業車：24282_eigyousha⟧: business/sales vehicle — used for commercial purposes
- {公用車|こうようしゃ}: official/government vehicle — for public-sector use
